name: Fake Android member, briefing, board, and voice-note API client
target: Run the actual Android NoteViewModel and MemberAppClient voice-plus-mid-recording-photo flow through fake STT, summary, storage, and HTTP boundaries, capture its real POST body, and replay that exact request through the real in-process member-scoped scraps API without external services
inputs: recorded audio plus a photo captured mid-recording
observations: briefing and board reads are restricted to the authenticated member
approval is idempotency guarded and rejects a foreign member card
actual Android NoteViewModel invokes fake STT and summary with the recording and selected photo, then MemberAppClient uploads and submits the ordered timeline

the captured Android POST method, path, authorization, idempotency key, and body are passed unchanged into the real scraps API, which stores owner-scoped audio/photo refs and hides the note from a second member
no external network attempts are made
